title.en: An Act Amending Section Sixteen Hundred Fifty-Nine of the Administrative Code, as Amended by Republic Acts Numbered Nine Hundred Forty-Five, Two Thousand Sixty-Eight and Three Thousand Four Hundred Sixty-Five
title.orig: An Act Amending Section Sixteen Hundred Fifty-Nine of the Administrative Code, as Amended by Republic Acts Numbered Nine Hundred Forty-Five, Two Thousand Sixty-Eight and Three Thousand Four Hundred Sixty-Five

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3596_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In addition to such sums as may have been provided in the current Appropriations Act, there is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
